Who we are
Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

As a Product Marketer, you will develop the positioning, narratives and materials that make Helsing's products clear and credible to customers, partners and decision-makers. This asks for a thorough understanding of our technology across both hardware and software, and the craft to translate it. Your work will directly inform how governments and defence customers understand Helsing.
The day-to-day
Develop and maintain core marketing materials — positioning statements, one-pagers, messaging frameworks and sales enablement kits
Embed yourself with our Product, Programmes and Campaigns teams to turn technology capabilities into product narratives that land with each audience
Collaborate closely with Communications, Events and Content teams to develop authentic product stories
Lead go-to-market for new capabilities and product updates, including sequencing, messaging, moments and materials
Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify differentiation, emerging trends and new opportunities
You should apply if you
Have delivered product marketing in a technology environment — including owning a launch end-to-end, with the artefacts and outcomes to show for it
Can translate complex or technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives without losing accuracy or substance — and have writing samples that demonstrate this
Have moved into an unfamiliar technology or product area and got up to speed quickly, without needing close supervision
Have built trust with cross-functional teams — product, engineering and customer-facing
Are fluent in English and German, written and spoken
Are motivated by Helsing's mission to protect democratic societies, and ready to engage with the responsibility that comes with it

Familiarity with the defence, aerospace, robotics or government sectors
Willingness and ability to travel periodically to our European offices
Note: This position may require the successful applicant to apply for and be granted security clearance.
Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields
Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital.
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individuals are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.

At its core this is a hands on senior media buying role. You work with live campaigns, make daily decisions using real performance data, and stay accountable for profitable execution.

You will turn real campaign situations into reliable ground truth, review agent recommendations against outcomes, and decide when the system has earned more autonomy. You do not need to be an ML engineer. You do need strong buying judgment, data fluency, curiosity about AI, and the ability to explain why a campaign decision is right.

Launch, monitor and own internal paid media campaigns end to end.
Make hands on scale, hold, optimize and stop decisions across live campaigns.
Track spend, conversion rate, CPA, CPL, CPI, CPS, revenue and absolute profit.
Work across performance and affiliate economics, with attention to offer, geo, audience, creative and platform differences.
Document clear rationales for important decisions so they become useful learning signals.
Review AI agent recommendations against real outcomes and identify errors, blind spots and unsafe actions.
Maintain realistic evaluation scenarios, golden sets and ground truth labels.
Work daily with the engineering team to translate business reality into measurable requirements.

At least 5 years hands on performance marketing, user acquisition or affiliate media buying.
Strong practical experience with paid social, particularly Meta and TikTok.
Strong understanding of CPA, CPL, CPI and CPS campaign economics.
A record of making good decisions with imperfect data and explaining the reasoning clearly.
Strong data fluency. You can read distributions, investigate anomalies and separate signal from noise. SQL familiarity is highly valued.
Comfortable working directly with engineers and turning operational problems into clear rules and acceptance criteria.
Fluent professional English.
Based in Europe, with reliable daily working overlap with the team.
Hands on operating discipline. This role is for someone who wants to stay close to campaigns, not manage them through reports only.

Affiliate networks, tracking platforms, MMPs, fraud signals or offer level optimization.
Quality assurance, experimentation, structured evaluation or annotation processes.
Exposure to LLM evaluation, golden sets, judge models, prompt testing or human in the loop systems.

## Your Purpose ##
The Retail Marketing & Client Engagement Manager is responsible for developing and executing the retail activation strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys, with the objective of increasing guest engagement, driving boutique traffic and supporting commercial performance.
The role creates and manages the onboard retail activation calendar, including events, micro-events, brand animations, VIP experiences and local initiatives designed to enhance the guest journey and maximize retail opportunities.
Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, onboard teams, CRM, Marketing and luxury brand partners, the role transforms retail strategies into memorable experiences that generate customer engagement, conversion and loyalty.

**Retail Activation Strategy**
* Define and manage the global retail activation framework across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.
* Develop an annual activation calendar aligned with commercial priorities, seasonality, itineraries, and guest profiles.
* Create initiatives that drive boutique traffic, customer engagement, and sales performance.
* Balance major events with agile onboard activations.
* Ensure all activations reflect the positioning of each brand.
**Event & Experience Management**
* Develop and execute onboard retail events, including product launches, brand showcases, VIP experiences, collection previews, and seasonal activations.
* Manage event concepts, timelines, logistics, and execution.
* Partner with luxury brands to leverage expertise, ambassadors, and activation resources.
* Measure event performance and implement improvements.
**Traffic Generation & Commercial Activation**
* Develop initiatives that increase boutique visitation and customer engagement.
* Create activation plans around new products, hero items, seasonal moments, itineraries, guest segments, and special occasions.
* Partner with Retail Operations to convert activations into commercial results.
* Introduce innovative approaches to attract diverse guest profiles.
**VIP & Client Engagement**
* Develop VIP engagement strategies with CRM and onboard teams.
* Create personalized retail experiences for high value guests.
* Support clienteling initiatives, including private appointments, exclusive previews, tailored product recommendations, and luxury brand experiences.
* Strengthen guest loyalty and encourage repeat purchases.
**Local & Destination Based Activations**
* Develop activations tailored to destinations, itineraries, and guest profiles.
* Build partnerships with relevant local stakeholders where appropriate.
* Adapt activation strategies to regional opportunities.
* Integrate destination storytelling into retail experiences.
**Brand Partner Collaboration**
* Partner with luxury and premium brands to deliver joint activations and events.
* Manage brand participation and execution standards onboard.
* Ensure alignment between brand objectives and MSC / Explora commercial priorities.
* Coordinate all required brand assets and activation requirements.
**Content & Communication Coordination**
* Collaborate with Marketing, CRM, and onboard teams to maximize activation visibility.
* Support the development of invitations, digital communications, onboard announcements, guest messaging, and promotional materials.
* Ensure consistent storytelling across all guest touchpoints.
**Performance Measurement**
* Define and track KPIs including attendance, traffic, sales uplift, conversion, engagement, and VIP participation.
* Analyze results and continuously optimize activation strategies.
* Share best practices and successful initiatives across the fleet.
**Cross Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with the VP Global Retail & Luxury, Retail Operations, Category Management, Visual Merchandising, Training, and onboard leadership teams.
* Ensure retail activations support broader commercial and guest experience objectives.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 7+ years of experience in retail marketing, luxury events, client engagement or experiential marketing.
* Experience within luxury retail, travel retail, hospitality or premium brands.
* Proven experience creating and executing customer engagement initiatives.
* Strong experience managing events, partnerships and commercial activations.
* Experience working with luxury brands and VIP clientele is highly desirable
## Your Essentials ##
* Strong understanding of luxury customer experience and experiential retail.
* Excellent project management and event execution skills.
* Strong commercial mindset with ability to link activation to business results.
* Creative thinker with ability to develop engaging concepts.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in an international environment.
* Strong understanding of CRM, clienteling and customer engagement principles.
* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.
* Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels.

Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

This newly created role will serve as the primary owner of DIRECTV ’s pricing architecture and one of the company’s largest and most sensitive revenue levers.
The Director will lead a team of three pricing professionals and oversee annual price increases, acquisition and rack-rate pricing, customer promotional roll-offs, new package pricing, ancillary fees, and other changes that affect the customer’s bill. The role will also establish consistent business-case standards and pricing governance to ensure decisions appropriately balance revenue, margin, acquisition, churn, and long-term customer value.
This leader will work closely with the Packaging, Offers and Lifecycle teams, as well as Finance, Product, Marketing, Content, Technology, Care, Sales, Legal, and Customer Communications. The Director will operate with significant autonomy, translating enterprise objectives into a 6–12-month pricing roadmap and leading complex initiatives from strategic evaluation through implementation and performance measurement.

Annual and In-Year Price Management (30%)
Lead the strategy, modeling, recommendation, and execution of DIRECTV ’s annual base price increase and acquisition price increase.
Develop recommendations for timing, magnitude, sequencing, and customer allocation of price changes.
Direct in-year pricing actions across the portfolio, including changes to SVODs, premium services, sports products, hardware, regional sports fees, broadcast-related charges, administrative fees, and other bill components.
Maintain an integrated roadmap of planned customer bill changes to identify overlapping events, cumulative customer impacts, operational dependencies, and churn risks.
Coordinate execution across Finance, Technology, Billing, Product, Marketing, Care, Sales, Legal, and Customer Communications.
Identify and manage pricing impacts associated with customer migrations, price guarantees, reconnect and winback programs, legacy billing platforms, and other operational dependencies.
Track pricing realization against the approved business case and recommend corrective actions when results differ from plan.
Pricing Architecture and New Package Pricing (20%)
Own the structural integrity of the pricing ladder across Signature packages, Genre Packs, add-ons, premium services, hardware, and other portfolio components in coordination with offers team.
Evaluate and recommend pricing for new packages, products, features, and services.
Partner with the Packaging team to determine how proposed content or product changes affect package economics, price points, step-up relationships, and customer value.
Maintain clear relationships between acquisition prices, promotional prices, roll-off amounts, and ongoing rack rates.
Assess pricing opportunities and other approaches that better align customer pricing with underlying content costs and market conditions.
Monitor competitive pricing, promotional constructs, package composition, and perceived value across traditional pay-TV providers, virtual MVPDs, and direct-to-consumer streaming services.
Pricing Construct and Roll-off Management (20%)
Continuously evaluate which pricing construct best serves the business — including everyday pricing versus roll-off models.
Analyze elasticity, roll-off behavior, and margin impact to inform construct recommendations.
Treat construct evaluation as an ongoing strategic function rather than a periodic review.
Enterprise Revenue Levers and Business Cases (20%)
Build and oversee financial models and business cases for major pricing, packaging, fee, discount, and revenue initiatives.
Establish consistent assumptions, methodologies, and decision criteria for evaluating revenue, margin, churn, acquisition, migration, and customer lifetime value.
Develop scenarios and sensitivities that make key assumptions, risks, and tradeoffs clear to executive decision-makers.
Evaluate pricing for regional sports, broadcast programming, hardware, premiums, SVODs, bolt-ons, and other significant revenue or cost-recovery levers.
Quantify the direct and downstream effects of pricing decisions on gross additions, ACPU, retention, package mix, migration, and long-term profitability.
Partner with Finance to ensure business cases align with forecasts, budgets, content economics, and enterprise financial objectives.
Conduct post-launch measurement to compare actual performance with the approved business case and incorporate learnings into future decisions.
Oversee the development of pricing analytics, tools, and capabilities required to support faster and more rigorous decision-making.
Pricing Governance and Cross-Functional Partnership (10%)
Establish clear pricing governance, approval processes, decision rights, and documentation standards.
Serve as the central point of coordination for proposed changes affecting the customer’s recurring or one-time bill.
Partner with the Offers team to ensure acquisition, retention, winback, proactive, and tactical offers fit within the overall pricing architecture and approved economic guardrails.
Partner with the Packaging team to ensure package design, content decisions, and price points work together to create a logical and competitive customer value proposition.
Bring forward fact-based recommendations that clearly articulate financial opportunity, customer impact, execution requirements, and key risks.
Present pricing strategies and recommendations to senior and executive leadership.
Team Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of pricing analysts and specialists.
Establish clear roles, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for the team.
Create a high standard for analytical accuracy, financial discipline, executive-ready communication, and executional follow-through.
Ensure the team develops a detailed understanding of customer behavior, competitive dynamics, billing platforms, product economics, and operational dependencies.
Build strong partnerships across functions while maintaining clear accountability for pricing recommendations and outcomes.
Foster a culture of curiosity, constructive challenge, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Our platform streamlines operations, unlocks new revenue opportunities, and elevates every step of the guest journey. Hoteliers can run their entire operation from any device, enabling staff to break free from the front desk and guests to personalize their stay from check-in to check-out.

We are looking for an experienced Event and Field Marketing Manager to lead a diverse portfolio of events that build awareness, strengthen industry relationships, and generate measurable business results.
The Event and Field Marketing Manager will own the strategy and execution of Stayntouch ’s event program, which includes several major industry trade shows and conferences each year, along with approximately 40 regional events, field marketing programs, sponsorships, consultant events, partner events, and smaller conferences.
This role requires someone who can think strategically while also managing the details that make an event successful. You will help determine where Stayntouch should invest, define the goals for each event, manage logistics and promotion, prepare our teams, and measure the impact after the event.
This is not a logistics-only role. You will be responsible for ensuring that every event has a clear audience, purpose, activation plan, and path to measurable results.

Event Strategy and Planning
Develop and manage Stayntouch ’s annual event and field marketing strategy.
Build and maintain the event calendar across major trade shows, regional conferences, sponsorships, field events, consultant events, partner programs, and customer gatherings.
Evaluate event opportunities based on audience fit, market priorities, relationship value, pipeline potential, cost, and expected return.
Define the objectives, target audience, success metrics, budget, and activation plan for each event.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and regional leaders to align events with priority markets, accounts, customers, and prospects.
Identify opportunities to create more targeted field marketing programs around important markets, industry groups, customers, and partners.
Manage the annual event budget and make recommendations on where to increase, reduce, or shift investment.
Event Execution
Manage the full event lifecycle, including contracts, registration, booth selection, floorplans, shipping, signage, audiovisual needs, catering, travel, staffing, speaking opportunities, and on-site logistics.
Serve as the primary point of contact for event organizers, venues, exhibit partners, production vendors, sponsors, and other external partners.
Manage booth design, event assets, promotional materials, giveaways, and supporting collateral.
Coordinate customer participation, executive attendance, speaking opportunities, private meetings, dinners, happy hours, and other event activations.
Provide clear event briefs, timelines, staffing plans, and expectations to internal participants.
Attend key events and oversee on-site execution to ensure a professional and engaging Stayntouch presence.
Manage multiple events at different stages of planning without losing sight of deadlines or details.
Pre-Event and Post-Event Marketing
Develop integrated pre-event marketing plans that drive awareness, registrations, booth traffic, meetings, and attendance.
Coordinate email campaigns, landing pages, social content, digital promotion, appointment-setting efforts, invitations, and sales outreach.
Partner with Sales to identify target accounts and contacts before each event.
Create event toolkits that give attendees the messaging, schedules, account information, and resources they need to be successful.
Establish consistent lead capture, qualification, and follow-up processes.
Work with Marketing Operations and Sales to ensure event leads are routed, tracked, and followed up with promptly.
Develop post-event campaigns that continue the conversation with attendees and prospects.
Measurement and Optimization
Establish reporting that measures event performance across attendance, engagement, meetings, leads, opportunities, pipeline, revenue influence, and cost efficiency.
Analyze event ROI and provide clear recommendations about future participation.
Conduct post-event reviews with key stakeholders to document results, feedback, and opportunities for improvement.
Develop benchmarks that help Stayntouch compare performance across different event types and markets.
Continuously improve event playbooks, processes, reporting, and activation strategies.

Five or more years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, or a related B2B marketing role.
Experience managing a large portfolio of trade shows, conferences, sponsorships, field events, and executive or customer events.
The ability to connect event activity to broader marketing, sales, relationship-building, and revenue goals.

Job Title: Product Marketing Director - Platform and Partner Ecosystem

We are seeking an experienced Product Marketing Director to join our Portfolio Marketing team within the Marketing division.

This role will lead our Platform and Partnership Go-To-Market (GTM) launch efforts, managing a cohesive brand and partnership strategy that positions interoperability and integrated partners as a vital driver of customer value and platform strength.

The Director will support scalable growth across our business, enhance our ecosystem value, and unlock new revenue opportunities for athenahealth .
The Director will manage a cohesive athenaConnect brand that positions interoperability and integrated ecosystem partnerships as a vital driver of customer value and athenahealth differentiation. As a key member of a cross-functional team, this individual will bridge connectivity between product, marketing, sales, service delivery, and the Partnership commercial teams.
This position will oversee product marketing for our interoperability platform and integrated partner solutions, focusing on product positioning, messaging, and commercial enablement programs to empower our commercial teams to effectively communicate the value of our market-leading integration capabilities to a broad audience spanning the healthcare ecosystem, including providers (ambulatory practices and health systems), payers, risk-bearing entities, and other ecosystem partners.

This includes developing cohesive messaging that highlights the unique value of our network and partner ecosystem for each market segment. In this role, the Product Marketing Director will support the growth of athenahealth ’s multi-tier partnership program, developing partner-facing messaging and leading integrated partnership launches.
This role reports to the Vice President of Portfolio Marketing.

The Portfolio Marketing team supports athenahealth ’s commercial go-to-market strategy through market research, competitive intelligence, persona development, messaging and positioning, collateral development and enablement, and product launch oversight.

We strive to deepen our understanding of our customers and their needs to create positioning and value propositions that evoke action.

Acting as the storytellers of athenahealth , our team collaborates across the organization to ensure that commercial teams have the knowledge and content necessary to create demand, win new business, and drive growth within our customer base.

Own product marketing for the Athena Connect interoperability suite: Craft a cohesive and differentiated message to support articulation of athenahealth ’s interoperability and integration capabilities, marketed across the ecosystem to providers, payers, health systems, developers, and other ecosystem partners.
Curate partner ecosystem positioning and value messaging: Develop and expand provider-facing messaging and positioning that articulates the value of athenahealth ’s integrated partner network.
Lead high impact product and partnership launches Oversee the launch of new products and partnerships, from messaging and positioning through commercial enablement, and guide matrixed teams supporting launch efforts with clear communication and strategic leadership - ensuring alignment with commercial goals and market needs.
Competitive Analysis: Work with internal competitive intelligence teams to inform analysis of competitors' interoperability products, strategies, and market positioning to inform differentiation and GTM strategies.
Commercial Enablement: Equip commercial teams with the necessary knowledge, content, and tools to effectively communicate product value and drive sales.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a liaison between product, marketing, sales, service delivery, and the Partner Marketing team to ensure effective product positioning and launch execution. Work in close partnership with Partner Marketing, which will lead partner campaigns, marketplace promotion, co-marketing, and activation programs.

10+ years of professional experience marketing within the healthcare IT / EHR industry.
5+ years of experience in product marketing, managing product launches, and developing messaging and enablement programs.
Strong familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards and frameworks (e.g., HL7/FHIR, USCDI, EDI) and a working understanding of the broader interoperability landscape is required.

About Anagram
Anagram builds lasting awareness by teaching people to see, think, and act differently in an always-changing security landscape. Instead of boring videos and pointless quizzes, we have puzzles, simulations, and an AI companion that coaches people in real time. We do more than check boxes. We change behavior by making ongoing security second nature. Fortune 500 companies like Disney, Kraft, and Pfizer use us because their employees actually absorb our training.
We're a Series A cybersecurity SaaS company with a bold brand, an impressive customer list that includes household names across retail, pharma, entertainment, and tech, and zero marketing infrastructure. We need someone to build it.
This is the first marketing hire at Anagram. You'll work directly with the CEO and COO to figure out what moves the needle, then go build it. The foundation is already here - a fresh rebrand, a strong product, an extraordinary set of customer logos, and a CEO with a real point of view and a story worth telling.
What's missing is the person to turn all of that into a marketing machine. What you'll bring is the expertise to know what to build, the creativity to build it, and the ability to get it done.
We're looking for someone who can build a marketing function from scratch and own every part of it
Turns our product into a story sales can actually use. You build the messaging foundation - who we're selling to, why they should care, how we're different from our competitors - and translate it into the materials that help our AEs and BDR close deals.
Builds inbound from zero. We've been 100% outbound. You figure out what's going to pull buyers to us, build those programs, and drive demo requests up quarter over quarter.
Creates content that earns trust and captures leads. You develop the assets (blogs, research, guides, tools, webinars) that make CISOs want to engage with us before they're ready to buy.
Makes our website work as a conversion tool. Traffic without a clear path to a demo is just vanity. You make sure every page, landing page, and CTA is earning its keep.
Gets Anagram surfaced in AI search. CISOs are increasingly finding vendors through AI. You make sure Anagram shows up in those answers.
Makes our Founder & CEO the go-to voice in security awareness. He has a story worth telling. You figure out the right channels and formats - conferences, podcasts, bylines, LinkedIn - and make sure the right people hear it.
Makes our Founder & CEO the first call when security news breaks. When a major breach hits the news or a CISO is looking for a take, our Founder & CEO should be the person journalists and analysts call.
Makes our customer logos do real work. We have household names across retail, pharma, entertainment, tech, etc. on our customer list. You build the case studies, pull the quotes, get the G2 and Gartner Peer Insights reviews, and turn all of it into social proof that shows up everywhere a buyer might be doing their research.
Makes HubSpot actually useful. Right now it's set up. You make it hum - lead scoring, attribution, nurture, pipeline reporting, and clean handoffs to sales.
Nice to have: background in cybersecurity or adjacent industries and familiarity with the enterprise security buyer.
It's probably not the right fit if you prefer
A fully defined marketing plan handed to you. You'll get strong context, a solid brand foundation, and engaged leadership - but the strategy is yours to build.
Depth over breadth. You'll move between product marketing, content, PR, sales enablement, and founder support regularly.
Playing it safe. Our brand is bold and irreverent on purpose. We're trying to stand out in a space that's historically been beige.
We have a generous pool of equity for future team members.

Additional Information
Working at Anagram
We're a fully remote startup that values deep work and flexible collaboration.
Values
Move fast, adapt: Jump in, make decisions, break things, fix them, and learn. If something doesn’t work, toss it and move on. Progress over perfection — we're always growing.
Ego-free zone: No jerks, no drama. Every voice on the team matters. We deliver results, embrace failures, celebrate wins, and make magic happen together.
Own it: See a problem? Fix it. Idea? Pitch it. Question? Ask it. Everyone has the power and responsibility to make us better. This isn’t a place for passengers.
How We Work
No timesheets: Results matter, schedules don't. Work when it's right for you.
Real-time feedback: Immediate, clear, and constructive. Growth shouldn't wait.
With kindness: Respect others, communicate with care, assume good intent.
Fully remote: Work where you work best. Twice a year, we meet in person.

Flexible PTO: Take time when you need it, federal holidays and Dec 24–Jan 1.
Optional Fridays: No internal meetings. Work or recharge as needed.
Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision provided.
Parental leave: Time off for life’s biggest moments.
Equity: Own a piece of what we’re building.
401(k) matching: Save for the future with company matching.
Stipends: Office setup, remote work, and learning support.

Über die Stelle Pflege ist eines der größten gesellschaftlichen Probleme unserer Zeit. marta ist die führende Plattform, die den intransparenten Markt für 24-Stunden-Betreuung radikal verändert. Wir machen Pflege einfacher zugänglich, transparent und bezahlbar.
Wir haben viel ausprobiert und viel gelernt. Performance-Marketing läuft. TV haben wir zwei Jahre lang mit echtem Druck gefahren. Mailing, Print und Partnerschaften kennen wir aus eigener Erfahrung, nicht aus Fallstudien. Jetzt geht es um die zweite Stufe: aus einzelnen Kanälen ein System machen, das trägt, und aus marta eine Marke, die Familien kennen, bevor sie zum ersten Mal suchen.
Darauf arbeiten wir gemeinsam hin: die erste große Marke für Altenpflege in Europa. Die gibt es bisher nicht.
Wir suchen die Person, die das plant, koordiniert und schreibt. Du denkst dir Kampagnen aus und bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material. Du entscheidest mit, welchen Kanal wir als Nächstes aufmachen und in welcher Reihenfolge. Und du sprichst mit denen, die das möglich machen: Sendern, Veranstaltern, Partnern, Produktionen.
Wenn du es leid bist, deine beste Idee in einer Präsentation sterben zu sehen, ist das hier der Unterschied: keine Pitch-Runden, keine Freigabekette, keine dritte Feedbackschleife. Du stellst deine Idee dem Performance-Marketing und den Gründern vor, und ihr entscheidet im selben Gespräch. Was montags beschlossen wird, läuft spätestens in der Woche darauf.
Wir sind eine der größten Plattformen im deutschen 24-Stunden-Pflegemarkt, finanziert von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, mit einem bundesweiten Franchise-System und Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig.
Level: Senior. Du planst und koordinierst: Kanäle, Budget, Timing, Briefings. Die Texte schreibst du selbst.
An deiner Seite: unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager. Dort liegen Analyse, Attribution und die Aussteuerung der bezahlten Kanäle. Bei dir liegen Marke, Kampagnen und die Kanäle daneben. Ihr arbeitet auf Augenhöhe an einem Funnel.
Founder-Nähe: du arbeitest eng und direkt mit den Gründern an Marke, Botschaft und Ideen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.
Perspektive: Head of Brand mit eigenem Team. Die Bedingung dafür sagen wir dir offen: mindestens ein zusätzlicher skalierbarer Push-Kanal, der uns spürbar schneller wachsen lässt.
Start: so bald wie möglich
Deine Rolle in unserem Team Du bist die erste Person bei marta, die ausschließlich für die Marke da ist. 8 von 10 unserer treuesten Familien würden marta weiterempfehlen. Diese Geschichte erzählt bisher niemand systematisch. Du gibst marta eine Stimme, ein Gesicht und Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Was du jetzt festlegst, ist das Fundament für alles, was danach kommt.
Was du machst Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben . Du entwickelst Kampagnen für Familien, die vor einer der schwersten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens stehen. Keine Werbeanzeigen, sondern etwas, das man sich merkt. Und du bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material.
Kanäle planen und koordinieren . Du entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes testen, in welcher Reihenfolge und mit welchem Erfolgskriterium. Und du sagst genauso klar, was wir uns sparen, weil du Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Kanälen mitbringst.
Texte, die du selbst schreibst. Landingpages, SEO- und Ratgeber-Content, Anzeigentexte, E-Mails, Videoskripte, Social, Print. Am Anfang entstehen sie an deinem Schreibtisch, zunehmend KI-gestützt. Wenn ein Kanal skaliert und wir echtes Volumen brauchen, holen wir Unterstützung dazu.

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re looking for several Senior Product Marketing Managers to own Product Marketing for some of Monzo's most important products across Core Banking, Borrowing and Wealth
At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets).

We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign & channel strategy, creative direction, and overall go-to-market approach to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.

Core is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.
Borrowing is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe.

This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.
Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.

Own Product Marketing for a Product. You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.
Become the expert on your market. You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.
Define positioning customers understand. You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.
Influence Product Strategy. You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.
Shape successful launches. You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.
Measure what matters. You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.

You enjoy owning entire products. You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning.
You solve ambiguous problems with evidence. You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.
You know what makes products win. You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.
You influence through collaboration. You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.
You're always improving and helping others improve. You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.

Consensys is the leading blockchain and web3 software company. Founded by Joe Lubin, CEO of Consensys and Co-Founder of Ethereum in 2014, Consensys has been at the forefront of innovation, pioneering technological developments within the web3 ecosystem.
The financial system is being rebuilt on open, programmable infrastructure, and Consensys is helping power that transition. From MetaMask, the platform trusted by tens of millions of users worldwide, to Linea, the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup and an emerging home for institutional ETH capital, Consensys builds products and infrastructure that enable users, developers, and institutions to participate in the next generation of the internet.
Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making the decentralized web universally easy to access, use, and build on.
Joining Consensys means working with a fully remote, globally distributed team of technologists, designers, cryptographers, product thinkers, and researchers who are building the next layer of the internet.

You'll be exposed to new ideas, emerging technologies, and complex challenges that push you to stay at the top of your game while helping scale products and infrastructure used by tens of millions of users and thousands of developers across the web3 ecosystem. You'll join a network of builders that reaches the edge of our ecosystem.

Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies.

MetaMask is the world's leading self-custodial wallet — and the primary gateway for hundreds of millions of people into the onchain economy. Our Trading features sit at the heart of that experience: enabling users to place a swap, a perp trade, a prediction market trade, or an investment in Real-World-Assets (RWA) with confidence.
We're looking for a strategic, data-informed, and user-obsessed Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the positioning and growth of these features. This is one of the highest-leverage roles in the MetaMask marketing organisation — sitting at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and long-term brand trust.

The Marketing Specialist (MarTech Manager) serves as the strategic lead for the Air Force Services (AFS) Non Appropriated Fund (NAF) marketing technology ecosystem, including the enterprise CMS, eCommerce, analytics, and related digital platforms.

Provides governance, product ownership, and enterprise coordination to ensure digital platforms directly support revenue-generating business units and enterprise marketing objectives.

Operates under the administrative and policy oversight of the Marketing Operations Branch Chief, who retains responsibility for enterprise compliance and inherently governmental functions.

Execute responsibilities in collaboration with Strategic Marketing team members, cross-functional AFSVC partners, and contracted vendors to ensure alignment across digital, technical, and operational stakeholders.

Performs platform-level system administration for the enterprise CMS and related MarTech platforms, including user provisioning, role and permission assignment, workflow configuration, template and module setup, and management of platform settings that support business operations.

Conducts quality assurance testing, validates vendor releases, troubleshoots functional issues, and coordinates resolution with contracted developers. Implements and maintains digital analytics and tracking configurations to support measurement of customer behavior, digital conversion, and business unit performance.

Configures tagging, dashboards, and reporting tools; validates data accuracy; and provides insights to inform platform enhancements and marketing decision-making.

Owns and manages the security and compliance documentation required for NAF-funded digital platforms, ensuring all system information, technical artifacts, and supporting materials are developed, compiled, and submitted in coordination with technical and cybersecurity stakeholders.

Initiates required compliance actions, tracks progress, routes documentation through appropriate offices, resolves comments, and ensures packages move through the full review and approval lifecycle. Authorization decisions and cybersecurity authority remain with designated enterprise authorities.

Develops, drafts, and compiles documentation required to support digital operations, including governance guidance, platform change packages, technical requirements, SOW inputs, and compliance-related materials. Staff documents through appropriate offices and ensure timely routing, review, and resolution of comments.

Prepare decision briefs and recommendations for the Marketing Operations Branch Chief. Serves as the Product Owner for AFS MarTech platforms, defining the roadmap, requirements, and prioritization of enhancements that improve customer experience, increase digital conversion, and strengthen revenue performance across business units.

Identifies capability needs and modernization opportunities based on analytics, user feedback, and mission requirements. Maintains product backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans.

Develops and maintains digital governance, including publishing standards, access roles, workflow rules, content lifecycle requirements, and digital compliance practices. Provides guidance to installations and program offices on interpreting and applying governance standards.

Ensure platform requirements remain aligned with enterprise technical and security frameworks in coordination with technical stakeholders. Leads development of Statements of Work (SOWs), technical requirements, and evaluation criteria for MarTech services, and coordinates with Procurement teams for contract execution, renewals, and modifications.

Monitors vendor performance and ensures deliverables meet requirements and support revenue-producing operations. Designs the strategy and framework for the MarTech training program and partners with Marketing Training & Development Manager(s) and the Installation Support Liaison for delivery, onboarding, and field communications.

Ensure installations can effectively use digital platforms to promote programs, drive participation, and support business unit performance. Communicates platform changes, updates, and requirements across the AF MilMark Network.
